exposure: maternal skin color (Afro-descendant, Euro-descendant, Black (preta), mixed-race (parda), White)
cohort: The study analyzed hospital records of 2845 infants delivered between 1922 and 1926 at the Maternidade Laranjeiras in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.
finding: Infants born to Afro-descendant women had significantly lower birth weights compared to infants born to Euro-descendant women, with further disparities observed among different Afro-descendant groups.
cross-section timing: Data collected from hospital records for infants delivered between 1922 and 1926.
birth_weight: Estimated differences in birth weight were -84g, -100g, and -70g for various groups, indicating birth weight was measured.
